entries.reason: test.event prints the flow sequence as +SEQ without the [] marker, and ends the document before the stray bracket. The sequence is complete but the document is not: nothing has closed it when the extra bracket is found. Rule applied to every recorded error tree: a document ends only at its end marker, at the next document start marker, or at the end of the stream. An error found before any of these happens while the document is still open, so no document end is emitted before it. The same rule leaves 9JBA, KS4U, 3HFZ and QLJ7 as recorded.
entries.citation: YAML 1.2.2 section 7.4.1 (c-flow-sequence, production 137) for the marker; YAML 1.2.2 section 9.1 (l-yaml-stream, production 211, and l-document-suffix, production 205): a bare document is ended by a document suffix, a further document or the end of the stream
